IMPACTS
A. Land Use and Zoning
Positive impact on land use by preserving established residential neighborhoods. Slight housing stock impact due to permanent and temporary relocation.
B. Geology and Soils
Various elements of project will be subject to the geologic and soil hazards typical of the Santa Clara Valley floor.
C. Hydrology and Water Quality
Certain project neighborhoods are subject to 1% flooding.
